item.title: Here’s Why the A-4 Skyhawk Made Such a Good “Enemy” Plane
item.description: The A-4 Skyhawk was designed as a small and nimble dogfighter—the same design principles used for Soviet aircraft, making it useful as a stand-in. The post Here’s Why the A-4 Skyhawk Made Such a Good “Enemy” Plane appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: What Is Aircraft “Low Speed Handling”? Why Does It Matter?
item.description: Pilots sometimes need to operate at slow speeds—during tight turns and landings, for instance—and good low-speed handling is the hallmark of a great fighter jet. The post What Is Aircraft “Low Speed Handling”? Why Does It Matter? appeared first on The National Interest.
